rows.grounds: thousand; locative plural indicating location within a large number
compound of yoni (womb, source) and yantra (mechanism, diagram); locative plural
past passive participle indicating those who have been afflicted or oppressed

items.question: In how many womb-mechanisms are beings said to suffer torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
